newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds closed higher on Thursday but well off morning peaks as the market failed to mantain initial gains.
The main focus remained on the U.S. market ahead of next week's meeting of the Federal Reserve's FOMC, dealers said.
Fourth quarter U.S. GDP, due tomorrow at 1330 GMT, could give some hints. It is expected to have grown 3.9 pct.
"There is a consensus that the Fed will end up in doing nothing, but the market is still very nervous," said a dealer.
The Italian market, plagued by foreign dealers selling after Treasury auctions, was pushing bonos down, dealers said.
The 10-year spread over German Bunds was little changed widening to 92 basis points from 90 at the start this morning.
Spain's yield curve flattened a bit, with the two- to 10-year spread higher at 130 basis points from 128 this morning.
